checks: validate strict work_package_v2 and every work_authority_v2
require the exact work_request_v2 preimage and work_package_v2 to be signed into the root Permit
recompute requested_authority_set_hash from the exported request and require every requested lane to be issued or explicitly excluded
recompute every authority_canonical_hash with that field omitted
recompute the sorted issued authority set and root package hashes
require exact project, root and resource correspondence, one pinned Policy snapshot, and issued limits and time windows no broader than the signed request
require each authority delegation to reference one issued lane and one verified principal
require every monetary lane to use the finite customer value pool currency
require non-monetary roots to omit a customer value pool
non_claims: does not establish current delegation or credential liveness
does not establish dispatch or external outcome
does not govern AI or model compute spend
